data_fields.name: block_hurt_dps
data_fields.donor_constant: from block data (zon dps), rate times delta time

best_idea: One entry point for every health change that clamps to [0, max], turns zero or below into one kill event with a full refill, and rolls back a predicted local change when the server refuses it.
decision_why: Keep the one ledger with clamp, kill-at-zero refill and rollback; reject the trust model: here the client sends its own damage and the server checks only that the target is the sender, while our kills must be server-verified and the server must compute landing and hazard damage itself.
acceptance: A server test sends a forged damage change and asserts the victim's health is unchanged; a server-computed 30-unit vertical landing deals 4 health with the donor formula; a kill respawns the player once at full health at the spawn point.
